caption: Three zones, three deliberate flows: the internet reaches only the load balancer, the load balancer reaches only the app tier, the app tier reaches only its data tier, and egress from the private tier passes through an allow-listed NAT. A compromised app server can reach no more than that.
alt: From left to right: the internet with users and an attacker; a public zone containing a load balancer and a NAT gateway; a private zone with application servers; an isolated zone with a database and a cache. Arrows show internet to load balancer on 443, load balancer to apps on 8080, apps to database on 5432 and cache on 6379, and apps to the NAT gateway for allow-listed egress only. The isolated zone has no route to the internet.
